name: klinger_divergence
status: research settings, not approved trading settings

formula.replay: every oscillator endpoint t is computed from exactly replay_bars + 1 trailing closed bars, rows t-replay_bars .. t inclusive; no state is carried between endpoints or between evaluator calls
formula.seed_row: at row t-replay_bars: trend = -1 (no earlier price is read), dm = high - low, cm = dm, volume force = volume * 2 * (dm / cm - 1) * trend * 100 (zero when dm > 0); the fast and slow EMAs start at that volume force and the signal line starts at the seed oscillator fast - slow = 0
formula.trend: for every later replay row j: trend(j) = +1 when high(j) + low(j) + close(j) > high(j-1) + low(j-1) + close(j-1), else -1; an equal sum gives -1
formula.cm: cm(j) = cm(j-1) + dm(j) when trend(j) == trend(j-1); cm(j) = dm(j-1) + dm(j) on a trend change
formula.volume_force: vf(j) = volume(j) * 2 * (dm(j) / cm(j) - 1) * trend(j) * 100; because cm >= dm, the factor (dm / cm - 1) is <= 0, so vf has the opposite sign of trend except when dm == cm (vf = 0); this is the issue formula, implemented as written
formula.oscillator: fast EMA(vf) - slow EMA(vf) with weight alpha = 2 / (period + 1), updated inside the same replay
formula.signal_line: signal_period EMA of the replay's own oscillator values (alpha = 2 / (signal_period + 1)), updated inside the same replay; never fed from oscillator values with a longer history
formula.first_valid_endpoint: row replay_bars (the endpoint needs replay_bars + 1 rows)
formula.zero_cm: cm that is not strictly positive (or not finite) at any row of an endpoint replay invalidates that endpoint (reason zero_cm); a zero-range bar with positive cm is valid
formula.zero_volume: valid: zero volume gives zero volume force when cm is positive
formula.previous_endpoint: the endpoint t-1 is computed independently from its own replay (rows t-1-replay_bars .. t-1)
formula.cross: upward cross at t: osc(t-1) <= sig(t-1) and osc(t) > sig(t); downward cross: osc(t-1) >= sig(t-1) and osc(t) < sig(t); both endpoints from their own replays
formula.pivots: strict price pivots: a low pivot at q has low(q) strictly below every low in q-left_span .. q-1 and q+1 .. q+right_span (a high pivot mirrors on high); it is confirmed and usable at bar c = q + right_span
formula.pairing: each newly confirmed pivot pairs with the nearest earlier same-side pivot p with min_separation <= q - p <= max_separation: the largest pivot index p <= q - min_separation, and no pair when that p < q - max_separation; no farther pivot is searched for a more favorable divergence
formula.divergence: long: low(q) < low(p) strictly and osc(q) > osc(p) strictly; short: high(q) > high(p) strictly and osc(q) < osc(p) strictly; equal prices or equal oscillator values fail
formula.arming: a paired pivot that passes the divergence test arms its side; divergence_test = false (the signal-cross-only ablation) keeps pivot confirmation, pairing, replacement, expiry, crossing and consumption and drops only the two strict comparisons; no ablation strategy is registered
formula.entry_window: an armed setup confirmed at c can enter only on bars c+1 .. c+setup_expiry inclusive; the confirmation bar itself cannot enter
formula.replacement: every newly confirmed same-side pivot replaces the previous same-side setup on its own confirmation bar, also when its new pair fails divergence or has no pair
formula.consumption: the first eligible cross in the setup's direction (upward for long, downward for short) inside its entry window enters and consumes the setup; later crosses do nothing; consumption depends only on the cross, never on whether that bar's entry was held
formula.opposite_events: long and short setups are independent; simultaneous long and short entries hold and consume both (an upward and a downward cross cannot occur on one bar, so this rule is unreachable under the cross definition and is kept for completeness)
formula.support: S = replay_bars + left_span + max_separation + right_span + setup_expiry + 2 rows ending at the decision bar k; S <= 200 for every allowed parameter set; default S = 172, grid maximum 188
formula.support_proof: an entry at k needs c >= k - setup_expiry, so the second pivot q >= k - setup_expiry - right_span and the first pivot p >= q - max_separation; the earliest read is min(p - left_span, p - replay_bars) >= k - setup_expiry - right_span - max_separation - max(left_span, replay_bars), which is >= k - S + 1 + 1; every cross in c+1 .. k reads endpoints >= c >= k - setup_expiry; every pivot whose confirmation could replace the setup lies inside c .. k; so every read lies inside rows k-S+1 .. k
formula.input_validity: inside rows k-S+1 .. k: finite positive open, high, low and close, low <= open, close <= high, finite volume >= 0, a timestamp on every row, strictly increasing timestamps spaced exactly at the declared cadence (frame attribute bar_interval_ms), no row received out of order; and every oscillator endpoint k-S+1+replay_bars .. k is valid (positive finite cm in its replay and finite derived values)
formula.runtime_freshness: only a Hyperliquid check-time frame carries a decision_time attribute; its last row is fresh only when the selected closed bar boundary equals the row boundary and 0 <= cutoff - boundary < interval; an untimed check-time frame holds (decision_time_missing); historical frames carry no attribute and use each row's own boundary
formula.reason_priority: frame defects (missing_columns, missing_cadence, missing_timestamps); else the latest row or timestamp defect in the support (nonfinite_input, nonpositive_price, invalid_candle_geometry, negative_volume, missing_timestamps, timestamp_order, cadence_gap); else insufficient_history; else zero_cm; else nonfinite_derived; else, on the last check-time row only, decision_time_missing, decision_boundary_mismatch, decision_bar_future, decision_bar_stale; else opposite_events, entry_long, entry_short, setup_armed, awaiting_cross, setup_consumed, no_divergence or no_pivot_pair (long side reported first), no_setup
formula.timestamps: diagnostic timestamps are bar open times in milliseconds (a native-close frame subtracts interval - 1)
formula.invalid_value_representation: invalid values are NaN in the evaluator frame and are omitted from check output; validity flags are 0.0 or 1.0; setup columns are blank on rows whose decision is invalid

ablation_long.role: signal-cross-only ablation of the selected long-only parameters

ablation_both.role: signal-cross-only ablation of the selected bidirectional parameters

obv_long.role: On Balance Volume divergence comparator, long only

obv_both.role: On Balance Volume divergence comparator, bidirectional

volume_weighted.role: volume-weighted comparator; it registers short_entries=False, so it is compared only with the long-only arm

selection.eligible: complete candle and funding coverage, every dataset scored, no liquidated leg, no incomplete-funding leg, at least min_train_independent_positions independent position clusters
selection.independent_positions: position intervals [entry, exit] pooled across all datasets and merged when they overlap; each merged interval is one cluster
selection.grids: each grid arm uses its own DEFAULT_PARAM_RANGES grid expanded over its registry defaults; on_balance_volume_divergence and volume_weighted use their existing grids unchanged

base.meaning: manifest fees, per-coin half spread and slippage

stress.meaning: manifest fees unchanged, half spread and slippage doubled (the manifest cost multiplier does not scale fees)

continuous_reference.definition: the same recurrence evaluated once over the whole manifest frame from its first row (seed trend -1, cm = dm, EMAs and signal line seeded as in the replay), with the same pivot, pairing, divergence, cross, expiry and consumption rules applied to the continuous oscillator
continuous_reference.scope: selected klinger_both parameters, every dataset, both windows, scored rows only

mismatch_classes.finite_invalid_hold: the finite decision is invalid (zero_cm or nonfinite) while the continuous calculation emits an entry
mismatch_classes.continuous_invalid: the continuous calculation is undefined at that row (non-positive cm somewhere in its history) while the finite decision emits
mismatch_classes.seed_divergence: both calculations are valid and their decisions differ because the finite replay restarts cm, trend, both EMAs and the signal line replay_bars back

continuous_reference.acceptance: every decision mismatch must fall in a listed class; an unclassified mismatch makes the study inconclusive

parity.decision: parity_diff.compute_parity_frame over the last 600 held-out bars of every dataset with the common close owner, direction both, window 200 and window None (every prefix), solo composer and batched explicit-paper slots
parity.indicator: for every scored row of both windows, the full-frame evaluation equals the evaluation on that row's own prefix and on its trailing 200 rows: oscillator, signal line, previous values and cross within absolute tolerance 1e-9 (relative to max(1, |value|)), and signal, reason and setup states exactly

verdict.inconclusive: any coverage refusal, no eligible training selection for a grid arm, a held-out sample gate that fails, an unclassified continuous-reference mismatch, or a parity failure
verdict.pass: complete coverage and samples, both primary candidate arms net PnL > 0 at base and stress cost, and at base cost each primary arm has a strictly higher mean net return than each of its comparators and a worst drawdown no larger than each of its comparators
verdict.fail: a complete study that misses any pass condition
verdict.edge_status: every outcome keeps edge_status=no_edge; a pass keeps edge_source unvalidated, a fail records study_fail and an inconclusive result records study_inconclusive, identically in Go and Python

cache_legs: none; the study uses only the hash-pinned Hyperliquid venue manifest, so no Binance US proxy leg and no --funding cache option is used
